easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Generous round timer, common letters, 3-letter minimum, and relaxed score targets.

medium.name: Medium
medium.description: Balanced letter distribution, standard 120s timer, and progressive round modifiers.

hard.name: Hard
hard.description: Faster timer, tricky consonants, higher score targets, and multi-tile round hazards.

extreme.name: Extreme
extreme.description: High-intensity blitz with 4+ letter words, rare letters, decoys, hidden tiles, and chained locks.

classic.name: Classic Mode
classic.description: Standard collaborative word discovery with progressive round targets.

speed.name: Speed Blitz
speed.description: Fast-paced 60-second rounds with 6 letters and rapid progression.

marathon.name: Marathon Mode
marathon.description: Extended 180-second rounds with 8 letters and escalating community targets.

community.name: Community Challenge
community.description: Center letter required in every word! Audience collaborates to unlock the vault.

solo.name: Solo Mode
solo.description: Single-player puzzle mode playable directly in the browser without TikTok LIVE.

gift_challenge.name: Gift Challenge
gift_challenge.description: Audience gifts trigger instant letter hints, time extensions, and score frenzies.
